question: Along the restricted weak-cover family E_alpha: y^2 = x(x - alpha)(x - sigma alpha) over F_{p^6} (#E = 4l, l prime), how does the cold complete cost of the Run50 index-calculus arms (quadratic root-table remainder IC and deferred-pair graph IC, sharing one descent stream per target) grow with l, compared with the strongest rho available on the same fresh public targets, over seven sizes p = 101, 127, 223, 383, 661, 1153, 1511 (b = log2 l from about 37.9 to 61.4)? Report per-size ratios against the expected rho cost as the distance remaining, per-phase and local exponents with intervals, and the paired deferred-versus-table difference. No tier claim is licensed by this draft.

claims.text: Per size and per IC arm (ic-table primary, ic-deferred secondary): R_s = sum C_IC / sum C_rho_ref over the n admitted fresh public targets with its 95% paired bootstrap interval, on M2 against the preregistered M2 reference rho-neg-b16; on M1 against rho-neg-b1 (registered tower) and against the Karatsuba-priced reading of the same walks. M1 is a ratio of lower bounds, unranked, unless gate G-cov passes.
claims.if_supported: A per-size distance-remaining table for this family and implementation, in the metric it was measured in.
claims.if_not_supported: An interval containing 1 is 'unresolved' at that size. An M1 ratio with G-cov failed is a ratio of lower bounds with no order statement.

claims.text: Exponent decision under the amended rule (decision_rule.exponent): alpha* = the largest per-phase exponent upper limit (complete counted phases, G-cov) together with the M2 top-pair local slope, against theta = alpha_rho_ref_fit - delta; verdict PASS, FAIL, HELD or UNRESOLVED. The v1 global OLS of the total is reported beside it as a description only and decides nothing.

claims.if_not_supported: FAIL: the IC grows at rho's rate (within delta) in some phase or near the top of the ladder. UNRESOLVED or HELD are reported with the statistic that blocked them.

hypotheses.statement: The IC's cold cost grows more slowly in l than rho's l^(1/2) on this family: with a full F_p-indexed factor base (about p classes) collection is about p relations at constant attempts each and sparse linear algebra about p^2 operations, so the derived exponent is alpha_derived = 1/3 in l (l ~ p^6); the descent costs a near-constant number of F_p operations per residual. At small p the descent's fixed cost flattens the total slope, which is why the decision reads phases, not the total.
hypotheses.mechanism: Joux-Vitse cover-and-decomposition over F_{p^6}: genus-3 cover over F_{p^2}, Nagao decomposition of 6 points (about 1 in 720 attempts). The derived exponent is the lane's model; it was not re-derived from the paper in this lane (research-kb unavailable).

predictions.metric: M1 per phase (complete counts) and M2 top-pair
predictions.minimum_effect: Every IC phase with work at >= 4 sizes has its 95% upper exponent limit below theta = alpha_rho_ref_fit - delta (delta = 0.05) at every band weight, and the M2 total's top-pair local slope upper limit is below theta. See decision_rule.exponent for FAIL, HELD and UNRESOLVED.

gates.rule: Every rung satisfies 101 <= p <= 1511 and every admitted target has l < 2^62. Every target outside is refused at admission, before any worker run.
gates.why: Critic F8. The frozen worker refuses p outside 101..=1511 and l >= 2^63 at PublicCurve::validate and in each IC pipeline, so the v1 p2017 rung (l about 1.68e19) would have produced no data in any arm. Behind those guards the closure has unreduced u64 sums mod l that wrap when l > 2^63 (audit below). l < 2^62 keeps every sum of up to four reduced residues below 2^64.

audit.method: read-only static audit of the 11c9a031 driver closure (examples/jv_sieve_deferred_pair_compare.rs, examples/jv_sieve_graph_compare.rs, src/cryptanalysis/jv_*.rs, residual_walk.rs) for u64 additions of residues mod l without u128 widening, extracted with git archive into scratch (no checkout).
unguarded_sums_mod_l: src/cryptanalysis/jv_rho_strong.rs:719-726 (rho walk: a = ws.a + aj; if a >= n { a -= n }; same for b). Wraps when n > 2^63.
src/cryptanalysis/jv_rho_strong.rs:759 ((2 * best.1) % n, (2 * best.2) % n in fruitless-cycle escape). Wraps when n > 2^63.

src/cryptanalysis/jv_sparse_kernel.rs:140-147 add_raw (s = a + b; if s >= l), used by dot, the kernel and the Krylov updates (lines 100, 202, 328, 343, 403, 439); its Fixed::raw Shoup reduction needs r < 2l < 2^64. Guarded by Matrix::validate (modulus < 2^63).

src/cryptanalysis/residual_walk.rs:132-136 add_mod (s = a + b) and SHOUP_MAX_MODULUS = 1 << 63 (residual_walk's RelationSystem); the IC closure imports only inv_mod, pow_mod, is_prime_u64 and mix64 from it, which widen to u128 or track signs.

src/cryptanalysis/jv_cover.rs:2999-3200 (rho_e* variants: (a + mults.0) % n) and 3795-3796 (run_cover_dlp_mode stream: (a + al) % l). Not on the driver's methods as far as this audit traced; wrap when l > 2^63.
audit.safe_by_widening: jv_extension_sparse_dlp.rs:90, jv_extension_deferred_pair_dlp.rs:117, jv_extension_quadratic_pair_dlp.rs:112 add_mod use u128; jv_rho_strong.rs:478-487 collision_scalar uses u128.
audit.guards: examples/jv_sieve_deferred_pair_compare.rs:158-160 and jv_extension_deferred_pair_dlp.rs:416-417, jv_extension_quadratic_pair_dlp.rs:421-422, jv_extension_sparse_dlp.rs:334, jv_sieve_two_large_prime_dlp.rs:160-161 refuse p outside 101..=1511 or l >= 2^63; jv_rho_strong.rs:972 asserts p in 5..=1823 for the native calibration. decision_rule.per_size_ratio: Per size and IC arm: R_s = sum C_IC / sum C_rho_ref with its 95% paired bootstrap interval, Holm-adjusted over the per-size tests of that metric and arm. 'Below rho at size p on M2' only if wholly below 1, 'above' only if wholly above, else 'unresolved'. On M1 with G-cov failed, R_s is printed as a ratio of lower bounds with no verdict.

exponent.text: Critic F1. The v1 rule (global OLS of the total) passes whenever a fixed descent cost flattens the small sizes; on the lane's own estimate.csv it gives alpha_IC = 0.119 (e=2) and 0.151 (e=3) against 0.488 for rho and passes both. The amended decision uses the largest per-phase exponent (SUCCESS_CRITERIA T2 item 4) and the top-pair local slope of the complete M2 total.

statistics.alpha_phase: for each IC phase with counted work at >= 4 surviving sizes: OLS of ln(mean phase cost) on ln(mean l) over all surviving sizes, 95% stratified bootstrap interval [L_phase, U_phase], at every band weight. A phase with work on fewer than 4 sizes blocks PASS.
statistics.alpha_star: max over phases of U_phase (and max of L_phase for FAIL).
statistics.top_pair: local slope of ln(sum M2 total) between the two largest surviving sizes, with its stratified bootstrap interval [L_top, U_top]; the three-largest-size local fit is reported beside it.
statistics.theta: alpha_rho_ref_fit - delta, with alpha_rho_ref_fit from CTL-rho-slope (must lie in [0.47, 0.53]) and delta = 0.05 (draft).

verdicts.FAIL: L_top >= theta, or (G-cov passed and some phase has L_phase >= theta at some band weight).
verdicts.PASS: G-cov passed, every U_phase < theta at every band weight, U_top < theta, and alpha_star >= alpha_derived.
verdicts.HELD: the PASS conditions hold but alpha_star < alpha_derived: the fit is below the derived exponent by more than its interval (T2 item 5: a fixed cost, a phase not yet dominant or a counting gap); held until explained.
verdicts.UNRESOLVED: anything else, including every case with G-cov failed that does not FAIL on the M2 top-pair.

exponent.reported_not_decisive: the v1 global OLS of the total (and on ln p^6), each phase's local slopes, the quadratic-in-ln-l fit, and every phase's projected size where it reaches half the total.
exponent.rerun_on_v1_estimate: rule-check.txt Part A (point values): e=2 -> alpha* = 0.333, top-pair 0.263, verdict HELD at the point (alpha* sits on alpha_derived; 190-197/200 PASS and 3-10/200 HELD in simulation); e=3 -> alpha* = 0.500, top-pair 0.422, verdict FAIL with G-cov passed (200/200 in simulation on both ladders) and UNRESOLVED with G-cov failed. The v1 rule passes both (200/200 in simulation). [pcc:unverified]

decision_rule.ic_pair: C5: per size, sum C_ic-deferred / sum C_ic-table with paired bootstrap; read only when the stream signatures match for every target (otherwise the pair is unmatched and the NB term returns; then require >= 100 pooled successes per arm per size before reading a descent difference).
decision_rule.wording: Critic F5: no 'cheapest', 'fastest' or 'ranked' wording for counted lower bounds; 'lower-bound order, unranked' until G-cov passes. M2 order statements only from intervals, in seconds on the stated host.
decision_rule.multiple_comparisons: Holm per metric over 7 ratio tests per IC arm, the exponent decision and the 7 IC-pair tests; every attempt in the family is listed.

timeout_seconds.rho_per_run: step cap 20 x E[iter]; reaching it is a failure charged at consumed cost

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed n = 32 admitted public targets per size; no sequential adding.
Sizes ascending; global budget 30 CPU-hours; stop before a size whose projected cost exceeds the remaining budget and report completed sizes.
More than 2 of 32 failures or caps in an IC arm at a size: report its success probability and stop the larger sizes for that arm.
Positive controls (planted, bridge) run first per size and host; any miss invalidates the instrument for that size.

invalidation_rules: A row from a binary, generator or nonce other than the frozen ones is inadmissible.
A recovered scalar not replayed as [k]G = Q on E is a failure, not a solve.
A target with l >= 2^62 or p outside 101..=1511 is inadmissible.
An IC worker reading anything but public curve, G, Q and l invalidates the row.
A preempted row's clock is invalid; the restarted row is used and the attempt is listed.
inadmissible: Changing sizes, n, arms, caps, metrics, delta, theta's definition or rho_ref after the measured nonce exists
Using the DRYRUN or pilot nonce for a measured row
Reporting M1 as complete, or ranking arms on M1, while G-cov fails
Deciding C2 on the global fit of the total
Replacing the preregistered rho reference by the observed cheapest configuration or by any single run
distance_remaining: T2 needs at least 24 bits across six sizes and a held-out size at least 8 bits above the largest fitted size. The frozen instrument's domain (101 <= p <= 1511, l < 2^63) allows at most 23.42 bits and no held-out size; a widened, overflow-audited u128 scalar path is a prerequisite.

T1 needs complete counted cost (G-cov fails today), an ecbench family plus `ecbench challenge commit` for this family, the T1 negative control (no entry point), VALIDATION.json, a cross-host audit receipt and pcc standing verified.

Strongest rho: no fastest external rho (section 15) and no measured Karatsuba tower; the M1 Karatsuba reading is priced, not measured, and the IC's own extension arithmetic stays schoolbook (critic F11), which favours rho.
No per-phase CPU time in the driver: M2 cannot decide a per-phase exponent.
owner_decisions: Freeze or amend delta = 0.05 and alpha_derived = 1/3.
Accept the 23.42-bit ladder inside the instrument's domain, or fund widening the domain (u128 scalars, overflow audit, new instrument pin) to reach 24 bits.

Which rho reference is registered for M1: the registered tower (rho-neg-b1) or the Karatsuba tower, priced or measured (rho-fold protocol). This draft reports both and quotes the distance against the lower expected cost.
Whether to land the counted linear stage and the null-count rows (G-cov) before running; without it C2 cannot PASS and M1 stays an unranked lower bound.
Whether to add an opt-in per-phase CPU timer (outside the counted interval) to the worker, so that M2 can decide per phase without G-cov.
Access to a fastest external rho or a host with one (section 15), or an explicit waiver.
Authorization of the pilot (local-eligible, about 0.5 CPU-h) and of the measured run (about 23 CPU-h on isolab-eks).
